scope: All unique unordered pairs of the top20 magnitude improvers printed immediately before this request; 190 pairs, not all32 improvers
candidate_rule: Saved standalone MAE<baseline, ascending MAE then feature name, first20; selection already used development
model: minimize sum absolute training errors for b0+b1*Z1+bm1*M1+b2*Z2+bm2*M2; same unpenalized median regression; no products
preprocessing: Reuse each standalone training median, mean and std, preserve both missing flags and every development row
primary: Pair MAE minus better standalone parent MAE on same18481 rows; best parent fixed from full-development single score
uncertainty: Paired 7d/14d chronological blocks,2000 draws,seed48+days; nominal intervals for all comparisons and simultaneous190-pair bands for best-parent MAE
decision: NO_INCREMENTAL_MAE_GAIN if pair MAE>=best parent; otherwise EXPLORATORY_INCREMENTAL_GAIN unless majority months improve over fixed best parent, nonconstant prediction and both simultaneous upper bounds<0, then DEVELOPMENT_ADDITIVE_LEAD
diagnostics: Monthly, both-valid/any-missing, concept groups, correlated values, identical missing flags, rank-deficient designs. Concentration for top incremental, top absolute and all leads.
exposure: Previously exposed development; no verified untouched holdout; pair-family adjustment does not undo prior feature selection
